Data Synchronisation

Synchronise data across multiple sites using Merkle tree verification to ensure data integrity.

merkle_sync

Merkle tree synchronization router for offline multi-site reconciliation.

This module provides the API endpoints for synchronising disconnected air-gapped instances of the Eisenhower Portfolio Manager using cryptographic Merkle trees.

Endpoints

All endpoints are JWT-authenticated and require the caller to have sufficient clearance to access the target programme sub-tree.

GET /api/v1/merkle-sync/manifest

Generate and return the current Merkle tree manifest for a programme sub-tree. The root hash can be compared with a manifest from another site to determine if the two instances are in sync.

POST /api/v1/merkle-sync/reconcile-delta

Ingest an offline .merklepack bundle and reconcile it with the local database using three-way version tracking. Conflicts are staged into isolated SandboxScenarios for review.

POST /api/v1/merkle-sync/compare

Compare a remote Merkle manifest against the local state and return a detailed divergence report.

POST /api/v1/merkle-sync/export-delta

Export only the divergent records as a signed .merklepack file for transfer to another air-gapped site.

Usage

# Generate local manifest
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"          "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/merkle-sync/manifest?root_node_id=$UUID"

# Ingest remote delta pack
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"          -F "file=@remote.merklepack"          "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/merkle-sync/reconcile-delta"
